jobs.title: a theme for the living room
jobs.what: A local reskin of Fireplace's room: one JSON file in client/themes (its colours, what stands on the mantel, the weather at the window), no code. node tools/themes.mjs new <id> starts one at Grandma's colours, and client/room.html?theme=<id> shows it as you save.

jobs.title: a ball or a hat for Fireplace
jobs.what: A new look players can pick on the couch, which everyone in the room sees: one entry at the end of BALLS or HATS in client/looks.mjs (a pattern and two colours, or a hat's style and colour). client/party-render-demo.html?scene=wardrobe shows every one. A new pattern or hat style is a few lines in the bumper and party shaders.

jobs.title: a Party minigame
jobs.what: A new round for Party, and so for Fireplace. node tools/new-mg.mjs <key> <prefix> "<NAME>" writes one that builds and plays (a sumo ring); make it yours. Ideas are in docs/roadmap.md's kits table: Snowball, Full Tilt, Big Fans, Hoop Hop, Pinball. Its tests, the determinism matrix and the online gate must pass in CI.

mods.name: Grandma's
mods.about: The living room at grandma's, at night: a fire going, pumpkins on the mantel, snow at the window.

mods.name: Christmas Eve
mods.about: Red and cream stripes, a green rug, baubles on the mantel and snow coming down.

mods.name: Haunted
mods.about: A green fire, purple walls, pumpkins, and a clear night with a pale moon.

mods.name: Summer Rain
mods.about: Blue stripes, light oak, nothing on the mantel and rain on the window.
